**Summary**
Join Guidewire’s Cloud Data Platform team, a group dedicated to building and operating our enterprise-grade, cloud-native data and analytics platform. We enable mission-critical insights and decision-making for P&C insurers by processing billions of real-time data points using the latest in Big Data and cloud technologies. Our collaborative, innovative environment values curiosity, technical excellence, and a passion for solving complex challenges.
  
  
As a Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and developing scalable data platforms and analytics SaaS services in the public cloud. We seek expertise in the modern Big Data stack and distributed systems to help us deliver transformative innovation and operational excellence. This is an opportunity to shape the future of insurance technology, working on projects that drive measurable value and efficiency for our customers and support Guidewire’s mission to transform the industry through AI, cloud, and data platform adoption.
  
  
**Job Description**
What you’ll do
  
  

* Develop and maintain robust, scalable Spring Boot applications for data processing and analytics.
* Design, build, and operate cloud-native, enterprise-grade data platforms and analytics SaaS offerings using technologies such as Spark, Iceberg, Kafka, AWS Redshift, and AWS EMR.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, efficient, and innovative solutions that align with Guidewire’s product and customer goals.
* Drive adoption of AI, cloud, and data platform capabilities, contributing to transformative innovation and operational excellence within Product Development and Operations (PDO).
* Support team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and monitoring.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

What you’ll bring
  
  
**Required**

* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
* 0-2+ years’ experience in a Software Engineer or similar role.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Ability to design and implement large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience with AWS services
* Programming skills in Java and SQL
* Understanding of distributed systems concepts (consistency, availability, durability, reliability, fault-tolerance, consensus algorithms).
* Strong grasp of algorithms, data structures, and performance optimization techniques.
* Eagerness to learn new technologies and a passion for innovation.

**Preferred**

* Proven experience building and maintaining Spring Boot applications.
* Experience with Spark, Iceberg, Kafka, AWS Redshift, AWS EMR, Terraform/CloudFormation, Kubernetes, and other modern Big Data stack technologies in the public cloud is a plus.
* Experience with Big Data and distributed systems.
* Experience in the insurance or SaaS industry.
* Familiarity with additional cloud platforms or data engineering tools.

Your Impact
  
  
We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers to deliver new features and enhancements for Guidewire’s cloud-native data platform, directly supporting our priorities of operational excellence and transformative innovation. You’ll help launch and scale AI-powered analytics solutions, improve platform reliability, and drive measurable value for our customers. Your work will influence the future of insurance technology, empower customers with actionable insights, and contribute to Guidewire’s mission of delivering secure, scalable, and innovative solutions worldwide.

The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:
  
  

* Flexible work environment
* Health and wellness benefits
* Paid time off programs including volunteer time off
* Market-competitive pay and incentive programs
* Continual development and internal career growth opportunities

All new hires participate in our in-person orientation process to ensure a strong start and connection to our unique culture.
  
  
At Guidewire, you’ll help transform the way the world’s P&C insurers do business, contributing to our wider mission of delivering innovative, data-driven, and customer-centric solutions.
  
  
The US base salary range for this full-time position is $86,000 - $164,000. Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.
  
  
We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.
  
  
We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.
  
  
We're building a cutting-edge AI team, and this role is for an engineer who wants to apply AI to real problems in energy. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll help build our
**Product Factory**
: an agentic pipeline that takes software from requirements and design through code review, deployment and monitoring, with human review where the risk calls for it.
  
  
You'll also ship customer-facing features using VLMs and LLMs, and build AI tools and agents that make teams across Fuse more productive, from customer support to warehouses and back office. This is an applied engineering role, not pure research: you'll own what you build, from spec to production.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Ship AI features for customers, such as personalised energy recommendations and onboarding from an energy bill
* Build LLM applications and agents for support, engineering, warehouse and back-office teams, including multi-agent systems and durable workflows (e.g. Temporal)
* Build the engineering around them: cloud infrastructure, integrations, and access control so users and agents only reach what they should
* Own evaluation: datasets, golden answers, human and LLM judges, A/B tests. Know whether a change genuinely helped
* Choose models by performance, latency and cost, and revisit as models improve
* Work with trading, operations and backend teams so models reflect real-time market conditions, energy pricing and demand and weather forecasts
* Monitor AI systems in production and keep them reliable

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience, with requirements varying by role level
* Experience owning an applied AI system end to end, ideally in a startup or small team, and able to explain what broke and how you knew it worked
* A software engineer who moved into applied AI, or an ML engineer who writes production code. We value both
* Strong Python (or similar) and experience deploying LLMs or VLMs into production
* Solid understanding of cloud technologies, containerisation and scalable AI applications
* Analytical, rigorous and quick to learn. You don't need our exact tools, just the ability to pick them up
* Bonus: PyTorch or TensorFlow; forecasting, weather and demand modelling; energy markets and trading; fine-tuning or RL; vision, document or NLP pipelines; agent runtimes

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
* Biannual bonus scheme
* Fully expensed tech to match your needs
* Private health insurance
* Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits may vary by location.
